Re   : Westlife Foodworld Limited (the ‘Company’)  
Scrip Code – [BSE : 505533] and [NSE : WESTLIFE] 
 
Dear Sirs, 
 
In compliance with Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we would like to inform you that post intimation of the financial results of the Company 
for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 to the BSE and NSE on 23rd October, 
2026, the Company will have media interactions, and earnings conference call for analysts and 
investors – as per the enclosed details, which would also be available on the Company’s 
website. 
 
You are requested to take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Westlife Foodworld Limited

Westlife Foodworld Limited 
Westlife Foodworld Limited (NSE: WESTLIFE, BSE: 505533) will announce its results for the second quarter that ended 
September 30, 2026, on October 23, 2026. Following the announcement, the management team will host a conference 
call for investors and analysts on October 23, 2026, at 4:30 pm IST. The call will commence with a brief discussion on 
the previous quarter’s performance followed by an interactive question and answer session. Call details are below:
Note: Please dial in at least 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time to ensure that you are connected on time. Audio and transcripts will 
be available within five working days after the call on the Investors page of the company website.
For further information, please contact: Chintan Jajal | investor.relations@mcdonaldsindia.com
